chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
The time of Maghrib is from when the sun sets until the stars become intermingled.

key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, performed after sunset
key_terms.تَغِيبُ: sets or disappears, referring here to the sun
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the prescribed time or period for an act of worship

ai.seo_question: What is the time of Maghrib prayer according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith defines the time of Maghrib prayer as beginning at sunset and lasting until the stars become densely visible and intermingled in the sky. It serves as a jurisprudential guideline for determining the valid period of performing salat al-Maghrib.
